unsaved identity differs from later file identity
accepted destination records format and enables overwrite
same file identity refresh keeps overwrite
identity switch keeps format and disables overwrite

harness.scope: Bounded initial implementation and state/compile checks; reviewed and corrected locally before final verification

limitations: History stays in memory per NSDocument/window; no cross-relaunch history is implemented.
Native repeat options reuse current renderer preferences and export format. Full Typora export-setting customization remains outside this change.
Original behavior reference is static resource evidence; this run validates replica behavior, not a side-by-side original GUI comparison.
